items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 132:1
items.html: For every upper one is necessarily one degree higher than the lower one. And behold, if the lower one has a Nefesh, and an illumination from the Nefesh of the upper one was added to it, it turns out that this illumination is one degree higher than it; and the degree that is higher than the Nefesh is called Ruach, and so forth in this manner. (Chapter 10, Item 6, and Inner Light, Item 4)
